Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "返还范围只明示受保护信息本身。", "name": "confidential_information_only"}, {"meaning": "返还范围明示信息及副本。", "name": "confidential_information_and_copies"}, {"meaning": "返还范围明示信息、副本及衍生材料。", "name": "information_copies_and_derivatives"}, {"meaning": "返还动作只针对副本或复制件。", "name": "copies_only"}, {"meaning": "返还全部来源所述相关材料，边界由逐字证据限定。", "name": "all_source_stated_materials"}, {"meaning": "返还有其他明确材料范围。", "name": "other_explicit_scope"}, {"meaning": "窗口没有返还动作。", "name": "action_not_present"}], "examples": [], "name": "return_material_scope_v2", "question": "只判断返还动作明示覆盖的材料，不把销毁材料范围复制给返还。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“5.2.1 return all Confidential Information including copies to the disclosing Party; and”"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disposal_return_material_scope_v2__31_33", "operation": "return_material_scope_v2", "unit_ids": [31, 32, 33], "current_units": [{"id": 31, "text": "2.1.6 to treat Confidential Information as being confidential and proprietary to the OSCE by using the same degree of care, but in any case no less than a reasonable degree of care, to prevent unauthorised use, dissemination or publication thereof, as it uses to protect its own Confidential Information of a similar nature."}, {"id": 32, "text": "2.1.7 upon demand of the OSCE, to promptly return all Confidential Information (in whatever medium), together with all copies thereof or, where expressly authorised in writing by the OSCE, to destroy or delete all such Confidential Information and shall confirm to the OSCE in writing that such destruction or deletion has taken place."}, {"id": 33, "text": "3 INDEMNIFICATION The Recipient agrees to indemnify the OSCE in respect of any expenses, losses, damages, costs, claims, liabilities the OSCE may suffer or incur as a result of an act or omission by the Recipient or its employees in connection with the Confidential Information and the Recipient’s obligations under this Agreement."}]}]}
